title: Native Lean equality-saturation certificate checking
summary: Formalizes a native Lean checker for certified finite acyclic e-graphs. The principal result proves that accepted class certificates connect a canonical e-class term to the executable extracted representative and establish its minimum additive cost among all represented terms. The development also covers chronological merge certificates, egg-style flat explanations, replay-backed extraction, and bounded certificate search.
